title: literary_review
description: The structured review payload the prose reviewer writes and the revision consumes. `severity` (critical|major|minor|note) is the IMPORTANCE axis; `blocking` is the INDEPENDENT gate axis — they are deliberately decoupled so a serious-but-non-gating craft note (critical, non-blocking) and a hard constraint violation (blocking) are both expressible. `type` is checked by `prose_check.py review` against the prose vocabulary, together with two rules the schema cannot express: a blocking finding requires verdict 'revise', and no findings requires verdict 'done'.
